Keep her face exactly the same as in those photos: a short, fairly broad oval face with wide cheekbones and a soft rounded chin (not long, not narrow, not sharply angular); sun-tanned warm golden-brown skin with a light dusting of small sun freckles across her nose and upper cheeks (as light as in the photos, never heavier); natural eyes with thin eyelids, thick straight dark eyebrows, a small straight nose with a softly rounded tip, natural full lips; and a short black pixie cut with a little volume on top and short sideburns.
